messages:
Sofia Lopez: Quick, very important question for the slack historians — if you did a 3am raid on the office fridge, what would you absolutely not leave without? :eyes:
Arjun Patel: Pizza slice from the back corner, always. cold-but-golden. :pizza:
Maya Chen: Whoever keeps the small tubs of gelato in the freezer is a hero. take my vote. :ice_cream:
Noah Rivera: Honestly the giant jar of pickles. regrettable, but iconic. :pickle: (also wakes me up)
Lena (intern): Is it a crime to admit i would take the leftover birthday cake? it's just sitting there in the Tupperware. :birthday:
Arjun Patel: @Maya gelato > cake fight me :joy:
Maya Chen: @Arjun i'll bring spoons to the showdown.
deploy-bot: Poll created: "3am fridge heist — pick one" Options: Pizza / Gelato / Pickles / Cake / Mystery Tupperware — vote with emoji reactions.
Noah Rivera: Also, bonus question: what's the most regrettable late-night snack combo you've made at the office? mine: ketchup + cold ramen. never again. :nauseated_face:
Sofia Lopez: @Noah that is a crime against taste. my worst is chip dip + espresso (long night of debugging). :grimacing:
Lena (intern): mine was putting sriracha on a sugar cookie. ate it while trying to pretend i had it together. :sweat_smile:
Maya Chen: Results so far: :ice_cream: x4, :pizza: x3, :pickle: x1, :birthday: x2, :question: x1 (mystery tupperware) — gelato is winning.
Arjun Patel: Gelato champions, we shall reconvene at 3am next week. who brings spoons?
Sofia Lopez: I'll bring spoons and a tiny playlist. @Lena you can man the spoons signup sheet. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Lena (intern): on it. adding a column for stealth (sneakiness rating 1–10) :clipboard:
Maya Chen: Also can we do a post-snack regret bracket next time. winner gets a sticker. :medal_sports:
Noah Rivera: Reminder: clean up after yourselves — fridge gremlins are real. :broom:
Sofia Lopez: Agreed. Short follow-up poll: best cleanup song? "Uptown Funk" vs "Don't Stop Me Now" vs "Happy" — vote with song emojis.
Arjun Patel: :musical_note: done.
deploy-bot: Poll closed automatically — final fridge heist winner: Gelato (4 votes).
